description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ziggs''' scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 2 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds and lasting for up to 10 seconds.
description.text: Active: Ziggs scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant sight of the area for 2 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds and lasting for up to 10 seconds.

description2.raw: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing magic damage and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 1.5 seconds, as well as granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.
description2.text: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing them for 1.5 seconds, as well as granting sight of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

leveling2.raw:
'''Magic Damage per Mine:'''
30 / 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 (+ 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45% AP)
'''Reduced Damage per Mine:'''
12 / 28 / 44 / 60 / 76 (+ 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 18% AP)
'''Maximum Total Magic Damage:'''
150 / 350 / 550 / 750 / 950 (+ 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 / 225% AP)
'''Slow:'''
10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50%

notes.raw: * The mine cluster is built of 2 rings, with 3 mines in the inner ring (radius pending for test) and 8 mines on the other ring (200 radius), all equally spaced. ** The angular offset is randomized on each cast. ** Because of the [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 135 detonation radius of each mine, the total possible range of a mine from the minefield hitting an enemy from the cast location is [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 335 units. It will often be slightly less as the minefield is not guaranteed to be angled the right way for this. * Mines will not explode upon contact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the effects of a single detonation.
notes.text:
The mine cluster is built of 2 rings, with 3 mines in the inner ring (radius pending for test) and 8 mines on the other ring (200 radius), all equally spaced.
* The angular offset is randomized on each cast.
* Because of the 135 detonation radius of each mine, the total possible range of a mine from the minefield hitting an enemy from the cast location is 335 units. It will often be slightly less as the minefield is not guaranteed to be angled the right way for this.
Mines will not explode upon contact with player-generated terrain.
Spell shield will block the effects of a single detonation.
